title: Detailed kite
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- kite body diamond -->
  <polygon points='50,8 82,42 50,88 18,42' fill='#ff4d4d' stroke='#ff9999' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- upper left panel -->
  <polygon points='50,8 82,42 50,42' fill='#ffcc33' stroke='#ffe699' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- upper right panel -->
  <polygon points='50,8 50,42 18,42' fill='#66ccff' stroke='#b3e6ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- lower panels -->
  <polygon points='18,42 50,42 50,88' fill='#66ccff' stroke='#b3e6ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polygon points='50,42 82,42 50,88' fill='#ffcc33' stroke='#ffe699' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- central cross spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='8' x2='50' y2='88' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='42' x2='82' y2='42' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- small circle decorations -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='25' r='4' fill='#ff4d4d' stroke='#ffb3b3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='42' r='4' fill='#ffcc33' stroke='#ffe699' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='42' r='4' fill='#66ccff' stroke='#b3e6ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='4' fill='#ff4d4d' stroke='#ffb3b3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- tail ribbon -->
  <path d='M50,88 Q42,92 46,96 Q54,92 58,96 Q62,92 50,88' fill='#ffcc33' stroke='#ffe699' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- bows on tail -->
  <polygon points='46,92 40,90 40,96' fill='#66ccff' stroke='#b3e6ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <polygon points='46,92 52,90 52,96' fill='#66ccff' stroke='#b3e6ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <polygon points='54,94 48,92 48,98' fill='#ff4d4d' stroke='#ffb3b3' stroke-width='1'/>
  <polygon points='54,94 60,92 60,98' fill='#ff4d4d' stroke='#ffb3b3' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
